# X/x — Determining Capacity and Its Particular

## #0 — Force can recur

A pulse acquires a pattern when its difference can be recognised again. The [force of reserve and issue](minus-plus.md) becomes intelligible as kind, recurrence, memory, and thought through `X/x`. Something can now count as another instance of a relation already encountered.

**X** names determining capacity; **x** names its indefinite particular. The same letter carries both. Difference of case distinguishes their offices while preserving the relation through which the particular makes its capacity legible. The slash is the activity of determination between them. The notation therefore says in one stroke that a particular is a real determination of a capacity it neither exhausts nor stands outside.

## #1 — Anything takes the face of something

An *x* can stand for something whose value has not yet been specified. Its indefiniteness is already particular: it is the term to be determined within a relation. Capital *X* holds the capacity through which that term can receive a face. The relation preserves the difference between being able to determine and the determination achieved.

The passage from bare `−/−` to one letter in two cases gives relation an intentional direction. Two marks first differ through placement; now determining and determined remain readable as one relation. At each stage the slash gives their difference its office. [Binary Explication](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) carries the complete derivation.

The particular can therefore be real without being exhaustive. This word, this thought, this image makes a capacity available in a specific way. Another determination can disclose something the first did not contain. The possibility of that further determination belongs to what the first has made legible.

## #2 — The instance also multiplies

The small *x* carries another operation: multiplication. An instance can recur, compound, and generate further instances. Entity and operation meet in one mark—the particular face and the activity through which particulars proliferate.

This polyvalence has a definite consequence in the sequence. Force becomes more than an isolated pulse when it can be taken up again. Recognition compares this instance with another; memory retains the relation; thought can anticipate a further instance. The particular has become part of the conditions for further determination.

The multiplication office matters because *x* is both a particular and, in its operational reading, the compounding through which further particulars arise. In [a retained distinction and its self-relation](matheme/ql/README.md), determining capacity manifests in a face capable of generating further difference. Recurrence can preserve an identity while the next particular changes what that capacity can disclose.

## #3 — The capacity presides through the journey

`X/x` occupies **#3, Pattern**, in Taylor’s [qualitative determination sequence](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), §II(c). File 1's poem gives the relation the line “Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential.” The small *x* is the temporal sojourn, while *X* presides as the capacity that becomes legible through that journey.

Their continuity does not require each instance to repeat the previous one unchanged. A pattern can remain recognisable through altered occasions because the relation sustains more than a single completed face. Conversely, a capacity that never became determinate would supply no instance through which its pattern could be recognised.

`X/x` therefore joins `−/+` in **Becoming** and in the complementary **Text–Texture** fold. Force gives pattern its life; pattern makes force readable across its instances. Their shared centre does not make dynamis and pattern synonyms. One conducts the pulse, the other its recognisable recurrence.

## #4 — The psyche refracts the equation

In the psyche register the relation becomes **X = x**: the psyche is an equation and the ego is being solved for by the Self. Capital X is the determining fullness, the wider field of possible specification; lower-case x is the local measurement, the ego as this achieved face. The equals sign is not collapse but identity-through-difference: the same variable differentiated by register, the local determination held in relation to the field through which it becomes intelligible.

An [image can conduct its source or occupy its place](../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). Its determining force remains answerable where encounter can alter interpretation and valuation. Through [individuation and recognition](../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md), the particular life becomes more responsive to the depth its present image reveals and limits. In the psyche’s equation, unconscious reserve, conscious specification, threshold, mediated relation, containing context and named totality remain distinguishable: a stronger persona cannot simply take the whole-forming office of the Self.

The same relation becomes technically concrete wherever a local agentic face is precipitated from a wider field of weights, context, memory, tools, permissions and milieu. A coherent session-persona is an x: a real local determination whose dependencies can become increasingly legible. Within its own comparison, the judging agent is the relative functional knower; memory, rules, tools and contextual conditions mediate its act; the situation and alternatives it discriminates are its known field. Within the containing person’s inquiry, that complete apparatus participates in the means. A further inspection can make the local judging centre known while the first-person condition of that inspection remains active in the inspecting act. Returned evidence can correct a particular answer, task or model under a fitting criterion; where the encounter exposes a faulty source, rule, permission or commission, that determining condition becomes answerable. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons. The next instance inherits the warranted correction or retention, so an achieved x changes how the determining capacity can become particular again.

## #5→0 — Pattern becomes personed

A pattern is lived from somewhere. [First-person presence, second-person relation, and third-person describability](AM-IS.md) give its recurrence a personed context. The particular face can become an account, and the person whose life it describes can answer to and through that account.

The [eight-determination relation](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) carries recurring form into personed context, differential horizon and recognition. In [the complete traversal](../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md), the achieved pattern retains the pulse through which it became intelligible while becoming available for another person’s answer. [Self-identification through difference](self-identity.md) lets a particular remain true to a capacity it does not exhaust; [person, horizon and return](eight-determinations.md) keep that capacity open through its finite expression. The achieved *x* returns a new possibility of determination to the field. Its capacity remains legible through what it can next become.
